title: The Letter of the Lower Danube
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Wendell Delacroix, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
